name: Original Oblivion new game: inventory and magic menu admission through ordinary Tab

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=1
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.05

at 0 command content:oblivion.esm:02466e GetStage
at 0 command dynamic:player:0000000000000001 GetDead

local ui=require('openmw.ui')
local frames=0
local opened=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 frames=frames+1
 local allowed=ui._getAllowedWindows('Interface')
 if frames==5 then print('Cold menu observer ready inventory='..tostring(allowed.Inventory~=nil)..' magic='..tostring(allowed.Magic~=nil)) end
 if not opened then
  for _,mode in ipairs(ui._getUiModeStack()) do
   if mode=='Interface' and allowed.Inventory and allowed.Magic then
    opened=true print('Cold new-game inventory and magic admitted through Tab')
   end
  end
 end
end}}}}
